Wide Picture Frame that was created using Blender. This model is the wide version of my picture frame model that I previously made. This model can be used for game development, animations, scenes and pretty much everything else. It uses the metalness workflow and is PBR ready.

  - Includes 2 texture UVLayouts in 2K and 4K to show how the model has been unwrapped

  - The model has been manually unwrapped, with matching PBR textures to its UVMap

  - This model uses a diffuse texture with an alpha channel to allow glass parts of objects to become transparent

  - The model has been organized neatly in its zip archive and labeled accordingly

  - Native blend files are included with pre-applied textures

  - Model is exported in 4 file formats (FBX, OBJ, 3DS, DAE/Collada)

Included Texture Types:

  - AO, Diffuse, Roughness, Gloss

  - UVLayout

description_text:
This is a model of groundfloormodern family house.
It has two main sides seperated by big stone center wall. On one side are master bedroom and room for one or two children, big open space for living room, dining space and kitchen.On the second side are closet for clothes by the entry doors, bathroom and toilet, technical room for heating units, washer and dryer etc, garage for two cars, workshop space behind garage, and room for garden tools, furniture etc with doors leading to the garden.
Dining space and living room are separated by big standing fireplace. And from the living room you can get out on the nice porch in the back of the house.
You have completely furnished bathroom(sinks, faucets, bathtub, shower door and some accesories), toilet and kitchen cabinets with sink and cooking desk on kithcen island. And table in dining area but everything else is empty, and waiting for your furniture. 
There are some textures as wall plaster and tiles, rock and grass ones, some metals, you can basically all see them in the pictures.
Everything is kept as low poly as i could. 
Rendered scene is not included. You can see on the screens from program how the scene you could get will look like. There are no trees, plants and grass.You will get everything else with the materials included.
Every model has two uv tags. One for texture and second for lighmapps for unreal engine.
Some of the interior shots are not so nice, I am still learning interior rendering... :)
I am including a possible floorplan in the pictures how I pictured the house could be furnished.
Complete number of polygons from everything together: roughly 1.2mil polygonsJust house with doors and windows, without furniture and exterior lights and paths etc: 893k polygons
Bear in mind that the exported file can slightly differ in polygons, scale and textures than the original Cinema 4d due to exporting.

description_text:
Alfa Romeo Spider (1966)El Alfa Romeo Spider es un roadster producido por el fabricante de automóviles italiano Alfa Romeo desde el año 1966 hasta 1993. Ampliamente considerado como un diseño clásico, que se mantuvo en producción durante casi tres décadas con pequeñas modificaciones estéticas y mecánicas. Las tres primeras series fueron hechas por Pininfarina en Grugliasco y la cuarta serie en San Giorgio Canavese.
Al término de su fabricación, Alfa Romeo continuó usando la denominación Spider para describir a las versiones descapotables del Alfa Romeo GTV (1995-2006) y luego del Alfa Romeo Brera 2006.

description_text:
This is a model of Eames Lounge Chair Wood (LCW) designed by Ray and Charles Eames in 1940s.
First subdivision version can be used as lowpoly.
there are 4 .obj files
subsurf 0 subsurf 1 edgesplit 1 subsurf 2 edgesplit 1 subsurf 2 edgesplit 1 separated into objects
--- Model ---
All parts are modelled with simple geometry for easy modifications later on and using subdivision surface.
In layer number 1, you can find the base plywood parts of the chair:
Seat
Frame
BackRest
Front Legs
Back Legs
Layer number 2 contains the little parts:
Screws
Bolts
Shock Mounts
Layer number 3 contains the cameras and plane underneath the chair.
--- Materials ---
Materials are set up with specular and bump maps for accurate realistic behavior.
There are 3 textures overall that are used as diffuse, specular and bump maps.
--- Appending into a Scene in Blender ---
1 Open the .blend file of your scene
2 press Shift F1 or File -> Append
3 find this .blend and select it
4 go into Group
5 select EamesLoungeChairWood
6 press 'Link/Append from Library'

description_text:
Full project of the single storey residental family house.
One living room with integrated space for the kitchen, walkaway, vestibule, passageway, boiler room, three bedrooms, bathroom, dressing room, large terrace.
Full project in Revit contains defined structural layers and preset materials (most from AEC library), defined light sources exterior and interior, any missing textures of defined materials in Revit can be exported from Blender file (they are packed into .blend file). Dimensions of the model are in metric [mm]. Model contain basic structure of the wooden roof truss. 
Full project in Blender contain the same things as the Revit project including defined materials with textures, light sources (interior and exterior). Six diffrent scenes (cameras and lighting) have been already set for render.  Model includes hdri lighting maps (day and night) for exterior renderings. Real life dimensions metric [mm].
Model can be used as a base for furniture and interior design as well as some exterior scenes. Interior is free for any kind of adaptation. Interior lighting, with basic lighting fixtures is defined in Revit project as well as Blender project. Floor plan is designed for single family with open daily living space and separated nightly part with bedrooms. Project contain some part of the site including plants and trees, fence, gate etc.
Model is made by a civil-engineer so generally,dimensions of the structural layers are properly defined although model shouldnt be used  for any kind of live built  before properly calculating structure with final defined/accepted materials and their cross-sections.

Bell Table Coffee Table, Sebastian Herkner 2012The Bell Table by Sebastian Herkner turns our perceptual habits on their head, using the lightweight, fragile material of glass as base for a metal top that seems to float above it. Hand-blown in the traditional manner using a wooden mould, the transparent tinted glass base asserts a sculptural presence in space, contrasting intriguingly with the solid brass frame on top while also forming with it a harmonious unit recalling the elegant curving silhouette of a bell. With its appealing reflective surfaces and contrasting materials, the side table adds a distinctive touch to domestic interiors. It celebrates the beauty of the materials with their colours and surfaces, along with the virtues of hand-craftsmanship. The Bell Table by Sebastian Herkner is a masterwork of traditional hand craftsmanship. Each table is handmade, meaning that small bubbles or bumps in the glass are a characteristic feature.

description_text:
Low poly wooden desk that was created using Blender.
This model uses a diffuse map for colors, a gloss map to give certain parts a reflective and shiny surface, and an AO map for calculating shadows. This model comes in 3 versions which are all included. One that is just the basic model combined together with no modifications, one where the drawers are separated from the body of the desk, and one where there is an animation made for the drawers that is 350 frames long. The two other maps that are included are the combined texture which combines the diffuse, gloss, and AO maps together and the UV Layout to show how the UV Maps for the textures are laid out. This model can be purchased separately or in the Bedroom Furniture Asset Pack.
Features:

  - Model is exported into 4 different file formats (FBX, OBJ, 3DS, DAE/Collada)

  - Uses custom wooden texture created with gimp

description_text:
3D Model of the small conference centre, two versions of the same project - one made in Autodesk REVIT 2020 and the second made in Blender 2.81.
The building alone, excluding trees and chairs placed inside conference rooms is 165k polygons. The scenes which contains trees and chairs are around 2kk polygons.
Building contain three levels: underground, ground level and the top level. Undeground levels three smaller halls for about 20-30 people, maintenance room, two bathrooms. Ground level contains main hall with large open space, three medium-sized conference halls for about 50 -60 people each, two bathrooms, one large hall, large terrace, utility room. Top level contain two small open space rooms and a terrace. Building has adjacent parking lot with 40 parking places. Site contains some exterior elements such as street lights, benches, flower pots, fence. Entrance to the building contain slope for the disabled people.
Main structure of the building is designed as a reinforced concrete frame, with reinforced concrete floor slabs. 
Revit project - done in Autodesk REVIT 2020, contains some information about structural elements of the building and finish layers. Default materials from the AEC library have been used. Real scale model [mm].
Blender project - done in Blender 2.81, made for visualisations, with many scenes with set lightings, camera views, defined materials properties, textures, interior lighting fixtures, hdri lighting maps. Real scale [m].
If you need model of the building which contain less polygons, simply use confrence centre lower poly.blend file. The model of the building placed inside this file is deprived of additional elements such as trees and chairs and is roughly 165k polygons.

It was made during the reign of King (Pharaoh) Akhenaten at the time of the 18th Dynasty (New Kingdom) between 1353 and 1336 BC.  Nefertiti was the main wife of King Akhenaten and lived in the 14th century B.C. description_text:
A waiting room or waiting hall is a building, or more commonly a part of a building or a room, where people sit or stand until the event or appointment for which they are waiting begins.
There are two types of waiting room. One is where individuals leave for appointments one at a time, or in small groups, for instance at a doctor's office, a hospital triage area or outside a school headmaster's office. The other is where people leave en masse such as those at railway stations, bus stations, and airports. These two examples also highlight the difference between waiting rooms where one is asked to wait (private waiting rooms) and waiting rooms one can enter at will (public waiting rooms).

- General

The original file was created in 3ds Max 2014 with V-Ray materials (2.0 and above). You will receive a 3DS, OBJ, LWO, FBX, SKP, C4D, 3DM and MAX file(2012 and 2014).

All preview images were rendered with Vray. You will get only the PP 589 Bar Bench and not the scenes used for the preview renders. Please also take into consideration that the preview images are the result of the post-production and the look of Hans Wegner’s bench 3d model in your scene may differ due to the specific settings of your own scene. Product is ready to render out-of-the-box. Please note that the lights, cameras, and any background not described above objects are not included in the product. description_text:
Made in Blender.
Previews are rendered on Cycles. Settings: 128 samples, denoising-OpenImageDenoiser.
Only materials are used on the model: The stand, the first round part, the third round part and the plafond holders use a material with a regular white color, metallic at 0.95 and roughness at 0.30. All other parameters are by default. The middle part has a beige color (HEX: B8AA83), as well roughness at 0.20. Plafond uses the same color as the middle part, but here the subsurface color is used with the color B8B4A9 (HEX code). Parameters: Subsurface - 0.90, roughness - 0.80, alpha - 0.95, everything else is by default. There is also a light bulb, its materials are made a little differently. We need two materials for it, we already have one of them, and we need to create the second one. The color will be white, roughness can be set small so that the surface looks glossy, transmission can be set so that the light bulb looks a little transparent, but the whole secret of CGI bulbs is hidden in the emission parameter - it needs to be set to about 300 (in the case of blender). So, to make a light bulb look like a light bulb, you need to enter in edit mode, select the thinner part of the light bulb (which is metal in reality), then select the metal material and click the assign button in the right menu (in the case of blender...of course), after that you need to invert the selection and select the glowing material and click the assign button in the same way.
Useless information: I'm russian and i didn't use any translators (Just kidding, of course I do...).

description_text: The Hall of Memories is a corridor filled with doors numbered from one to infinity, or at least to 28. Each door linked to one distinct memory in one's current life and previous lifes. The corridor it self is manly built with stone of some kind and accompanying arched ceiling windows casting light from an unknown source. The ceiling is also outfitted with chandaliers along the length of the corridor.Notes:The Hall of Memories 1 section has 15,382 faces, 15,620 Vertices and 31,177 edges.The Hall of Memories Corridor has 216,903 faces, 219,436 Vertices and 438627 edges. Understand that this is the whole corridor, not the single section!Everything is UV-mapped for easy texturing. Keep in mind even though everything is UV-mapped everything inside the scene does not have a texture made from an image but a material made inside the program like the chandaliers' brass material or the glowing lights from them made with a emission material.I used Blender as the main 3D program and GIMP as the texturing program where I made a textures, Rough maps and Normal Maps by hand.I used the EEVEE render enginge inside Blender to render out my images where 1 took between 30s to 80s to render depending on how high you put your settings compared to the cycles render engine, much like Autodesk's Maya's Arnold render engine, which took around 6 minues (300s).

The perfect model for perfect renders!  
Maximum detail with minimum polygons! <<

  - Model objects are logically named for ease of scene management.

  - No part-name confusion when importing several models into a scene.

  - No cleaning up necessary just drop your models into the scene and start rendering.

  - No special plugin needed to open scene.

  - Model does not include any backgrounds, cameras or lights used in preview images.

  - 3ds Max 2016 V-Ray

description_text:
Upcycling a rubber maid plastic storage tub into a functional end table these connector pieces along with 4 small pieces of ½” copper pipe and standard   grid from an overhead lighting panel create a functional furniture piece. The sci-fi grunge styling with its alien looking top corners snap into place  with the pipe inserts and   top lock stops.   Both the   leg pieces and top corners print easily in resolutions from 200-400 microns with knock off supports included.   
Supporting a smaller living footprint this design integrates storage space into daily living. The leg pieces are hot glued on and come off easily when required. The top connecting pieces snap on and off so that the storage tub is also accessible. When moving time arrives all pieces stow inside.  All   pieces were printed with a $300 makibox 3D printer.   
Materials List:   1 -62 inch piece of ½ inch copper tubing,  overhead lighting panel grid 24 x 48 inches (makes 3 table tops  also comes in chrome), copper tube cutter: $9 Walmart,  roughneck 18 gallon (68 litre) storage box
Copper pipe cut list:  2 pieces 18 3/8 inches (468 mm), 2 pieces 12 ¼ inches (310 mm) Lighting grid size cut with small side cutters:  14 1/8 x 19 ¾ inches  ( 360 mm x 502 mm)Roughneck 18 gallon (68 litre) storage box

The Breville BJE510 Juice Fountain Multi-Speed with variable speeds is a smart juicer that adjusts speed to extract the maximum juice with minimal waste. A built-in smart chip increases power to the cutting disc under heavy loads so juicing is accomplished as efficiently as possible.
Juicing Versatility and Power
Fruit is largely composed of water, but its selling point is its nutritional value. How do you extract the juice from fruit, without leaving the nutrients behind? Breville’s Nutri Disc and patented juicing system extracts more nutrients than other juicers and transfers less than 1.8F of heat to protect enzymes and maximize nutrient absorption of select nutrients.
The 900 watt motor has speeds ranging from 6500 rpm for softer fruits and leafy greens like cantaloupe or spinach to 12500 rpm for maximum extraction from denser foods like apples or beets. A smart chip allows the juicer to sense the load and adjust power accordingly, making juicing more efficient.
The uniquely designed juicing system features an extra-wide feed chute that is centered over the shredding disc. This allows for more efficient juicing than systems that introduce ingredients on the side of the shredding disc. The 3' chute eliminates the need to pre-chop ingredients before feeding them into the juicer, saving you time.

CONCETTO SPAZIALEDESIGN FABRIZIO CRISÀConcetto Spaziale is the new vertical Elica hood in Cristalplant, a special material that allows for a ‘stylish’  play of curves, giving it softness and dynamism. The use of Cristalplant, a material that is worked through cast molding, accentuates the curves of the products, leaving total freedom of expression for design, thus making the shapes three-dimensional. Available in two colors, slate black and matte white, the new Elica hood reaches the highest levels of efficiency in terms of low noise and performance, also thanks to the aspiration system which is ‘designed’ by the curves of the hood in two different areas, one in the centre and the other in the rear side of the appliance. The innovative Tune-White feature allows for the adjustment of the tonality of white of the lighting, based on your living space and architecture. Therefore, allowing you to adapt the hood light with the other lighting features in the kitchen. description_text:
During my design studies, I've seen the rocking chair hasn't evolved a lot. In most cases, when we have many rocking chairs, they become quickly cumbersome. Also, this kind of chair with their design is always linked to the relaxation and nothing else. So in this model, I decided to combine many characteristics, as funny as it's practical, with always a simple use. 
I designed this rocking chair to be made easily by anyone in a fablab, and to be used both inside and outside. It is robust, stackable and the simple assembly just needs wood glue. We can enjoy in two positions: the regular one, and in reverse sens as you are riding a wooden horse. The rocking's curve was studied to give to this chair a very low center of gravity. The goal is to avoid any kind of fall and thus develop a confidence with the user. This rocking chair, for its simple design and its ludic aspect, will be quickly appreciated by adults and children as well.

description_text:
Cover chair by Muuto.
Right click on image and choose 'Open image in new tab' to see the full size.
MODEL
The scene units are millimeters. The model has real-life dimensions.
The chair consists of two objects grouped together (Sub-D and polygon mesh). Pivot of the group placed at the bottom of the bounding box. No lights, cameras and unnecessary or hidden geometry in the scene.

  - 
Polycount: 19 128 (32 312 faces)

  - 
Vertex count: 19 720

Please note that for Sub-D objects in 3DS Max statistics shows number of faces (triangles), not quads.
FORMATS
For those who use V-Ray version lower than 3.10.01 choose the file with Blinn BRDF.

  - 
3DS Max 2018, V-Ray 3.60.03 (Microfacet GTR (GGX) BRDF)

  - 
3DS Max 2015, V-Ray 3.60.03 (Microfacet GTR (GGX) BRDF)

  - 
3DS Max 2015, V-Ray 3.60.03 (Blinn BRDF)

  - 
3DS Max 2018, Corona 1.7

  - 
3DS Max 2015, Corona 1.7

Non-native formats:

  - 
Autodesk FBX (.fbx) (embedded maps)

  - 
Wavefront OBJ (.obj) (with materials)

PREVIEWS
The preview images rendered with V-Ray 3.60.03, but all the materials were also tested with Corona 1.7 in a similar lighting setup. Wireframes rendered with 'Isoline Display' turned on.
If you have any questions feel free to ask me via personal messages on the site.

description_text:
Beetle chair by Gubi.
Right click on image and choose 'Open image in new tab' to see the full size.
MODEL
The scene units are centimeters. The model has real-life dimensions.
The chair consists of two objects and grouped together (Sub-D seat and polygon mesh legs). Pivot of the group placed at the bottom of the bounding box. No lights, cameras and unnecessary or hidden geometry in the scene.

  - 
Polycount: 29 264 (56 080 faces)

  - 
Vertex count: 29 388

Please note that for Sub-D objects in 3DS Max statistics shows number of faces (triangles), not quads. That's why the real polycount is twice as less.
FORMATS
For those who use V-Ray version lower than 3.10.01 choose the file with Blinn BRDF.

  - 
3DS Max 2018, V-Ray 3.60.03 (Microfacet GTR (GGX) BRDF)

  - 
3DS Max 2015, V-Ray 3.60.03 (Microfacet GTR (GGX) BRDF)

  - 
3DS Max 2015, V-Ray 3.60.03 (Blinn BRDF)

  - 
3DS Max 2018, Corona 1.7

  - 
3DS Max 2015, Corona 1.7

Non-native formats:

  - 
Autodesk FBX (.fbx) (embedded maps)

  - 
Wavefront OBJ (.obj) (with materials)

PREVIEWS
The preview images rendered with V-Ray 3.60.03, but all the materials were also tested with Corona 1.7 in a similar lighting setup. Wireframes rendered with 'Isoline Display' turned on.
If you have any questions feel free to ask me via personal messages on the site.

The model is included in the Models4d Volume 7 collection.

To decrease the number of polygons, select all splines, change the intermediate points from 'natural' to 'adaptive' and set the angle at 5 °.

In the model there aren't scenes, bookcases and various objects.

The second dumbest creature in the universe, this creature's thought patterns go swim, swim, hungry, swim, swim, hungry. They'll eat anything alive and moving near them, though they prefer heroes.  ”—Commander Keen 4 Manual
The Dopefish is a buck-toothed fish found in the Well of Wishes in Commander Keen: Goodbye Galaxy!. The Dopefish is the second dumbest creature in the universe; the first dumbest is mentioned in the Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy as the Ravenous Bugblatter Beast of Traal that believes if you can't see it, it can't see you, thus making you safe from it if you throw a towel over your head.
The Dopefish was originally drawn by Tom Hall as a stupid fish, but it became extremely popular with fans of Commander Keen. Apogee Software then started to use it for its tech support staff. It then became a gag among Id Software, Apogee, and their friends to put the Dopefish as a cameo character in their games.

Why Do you need to buy this 3D model ?
I modeled and created this exclusive table with large tablecloth to church sassions, but you can use for other purposes without the red part or the cloch part to fullfill diferent uses and compositions. It gets amazing in large interiors and exterior places such in halls, kitchens, restaurants, partys and much more. 
And also I created 2 collections of PBR options painted textures to add a pinch of lifetime realism for this model to really suits well in everywere that you do and I included flash materials also in the docs.
There are 3 ways to use it and one of these It's going to fits well in any game engine and real time renders because it's very low poly with good normals and nice topoligy, no ngons or trianguls that allows you to modifie preatty easy the mesh and the normals are fine and will be more easy to put modifiers such subdivision also. And only in the 3DSMax and Blender doc you already have crease on the edges to make easy to use OpenSubdivisions without the need to slide edges. So I creted 2 options of use for who works with reytrace renders or use in game engines with textures maps istead and all with 4K and 2K resolution that I baked and will brings the same qualitie with no subdivion and not only that, if you don't want to use subdivision I included High Poly mesh in the file, all with UVs and the textures also works on these meshs.
And the object have proper pivot points locations to make it easy and precise to put in any place for instance.

description_text:
The Torso of my Edaphosaurus Novomexicanus, modified for STL printing.  Assembled dimensions are approximately 5.53 in X 9.96 in X 5.98 in (14.04 cm X 25.29 cm X 15.2 cm ).
Some assembly required.  Video assembly guide included (in AVI).
Note 1: This is my second experiment in posing a model before preparing it for STL printing.  In this case, I wasn't able to fit all the pieces on a 15 cm X 15 cm plane, so I have the six components in separate STL files in the same folder.  The video assembly guide and the pictures reflect this.
Note 2: While I have a link to the assembly guide on YouTube, I have other assembly guides that you may want to see.  All the models for which I have assembly guides thus far are Dilophosaurus, Eolambia, Short-faced Bear (a. k. a. Arctodus), Uintatherium, Dimetrodon, and Edaphosaurus.  To see each of the guides for each of these models that require assembly, just enter the name of the model, followed by "assembly guide".
Note 3: I modeled these in various versions of the Blender modeling program.  While I've been able to export the models in OBJ and STL formats, I've had problems exporting to the Direct X .X format.  I can export non-animated models to that format, and I can export models to that format with the armature intact; but, while the models deform with the armature before the export, afterwards they don't.  If anyone has had success exporting to .X format in Blender with a model that deforms with the armature, and can give me specific instructions on how I can get it to work for me, please let me know.  I look forward to comments on this subject, as well as comments on the assembly guides and the models I've uploaded here.

description_text:
This nozzle is designed for producing a laminar high flow water stream from low to medium/high faucet setting. If turned fully on, the flow may get turbulent though. Fits most standard M20 faucets with inside thread, an inlay version for faucets with filter inlay is available as well. Can be printed without supports with the outlet facing the printbed. This model is not designed to save water, but it is really fun to play with the laminar stream at low settings. There are various very interesting effects to be observed.
German Version:Diese Düse ist für die Erzeugung eines laminaren Wasserstroms mit hohem Durchfluss von niedriger bis mittlerer / hoher Wasserhahneinstellung ausgelegt. Wenn der Wasserhahn voll offen ist, kann die Strömung jedoch turbulent werden. Passend für die meisten Standard-M20-Wasserhähne mit Innengewinde. Eine Inlay-Version für Wasserhähne mit Filter Einsatz ist ebenfalls erhältlich. Kann ohne Stützen gedruckt werden, wobei der Auslass zum Druckbett zeigen sollte. Dieses Modell wurde nicht entwickelt, um Wasser zu sparen, aber es macht wirklich Spaß, mit dem laminaren Strom bei niedrigen Einstellungen zu spielen. Es sind verschiedene sehr interessante Effekte zu beobachten. Ein weiterer Vorteil ist, dass hohe Flussraten bei geringer Empfindlichkeit für Verkalkung erzielt werden können.

description_text:
Game ready low-poly Electric Shaver model in 2 colors with PBR textures for game engines/renderers.
This product is intended for game/real time/background use. This model is not intended for subdivision. Renders done in Marmoset Toolbag 3. Default render in Blender will NOT look like the preview images. The Marmoset Toolbag scene is included.
The textures in the embedded Marmoset preview are somewhat compressed. The textures you get when you purchase this product have better quality.
||SPECS||

  - Geometry is triangulated to ensure best shading.

  - Model unwrapped manually to make most efficient use of the UV space.

  - All materials and objects named appropriately.

  - Scaled to approximate real world size.

  - Tested in Marmoset Toolbag 3(see renders).

  - Tested in Unreal Engine 4.

  - Tested in Unity Engine.

  - Unity and Unreal Engine 4 projects included.

  - No special plugins needed.

  - .dae, .abc, .stl, .obj and .fbx versions exported from Blender 2.83.

|| Textures ||
4096x4096 textures for Shaver

  - General PBR Metallic/Roughness  textures: BaseColor, Metallic, Roughness, Normal(DirectX), Normal(OpenGL), AO.

  - Unity Textures: Albedo, MetallicSmoothness, Normal(OpenGL), AO.

  - Unreal Engine 4 textures: BaseColor, OcclusionRoughnessMetallic, Normal(DirectX).

  - PBR Specular/Glossiness textures: Diffuse, Specular, Glossiness, Normal(DirectX), Normal(OpenGL), AO.

All textures in png format. Substance Painter source files also available in the extra downloads so that you can easily alter the textures as you wish with Substance Painter.

description_text:
Sofa ottoman that was created using Blender. This is a living room sofa ottoman that can be used in game development, animations, scenes and much more. This models purpose is to be used in a living room setting but it is not limited to that. It comes with a red diffuse texture and a classic diffuse texture which is black, similar to my previous living room asset pack.
Features:

  - Uses metalness workflow and is PBR ready

  - Includes 6 textures 2048x2048 in PNG format

  - 3 pre-applied in native blend file

  - 1 classic diffuse texture

  - 1 extra texture depending on the workflow you use

  - 1 UVLayout texture

  - Textures can be edited in any photo editing software

  - Model has been unwrapped with matching textures to its UVMap

  - Model is exported in 4 file formats (FBX, OBJ, 3DS, DAE/Collada)

  - Native blend file is included with pre-applied textures and materials

  - Model is also included in my Living Room Asset Pack found here: https://www.cgtrader.com/3d-model-collections/living-room-asset-pack

Included Texture Types:

  - AO, Diffuse, Diffuse-Classic, Roughness, Gloss

  - UVLayout

description_text:
Did you see that? Feels like someone or something is with us in this dark bedroom. Or maybe just your younger brother with a bed sheet over his head trying to get a good scare. Download this classic spooky bed sheet ghost for you Halloween scene. Edit the material to change how transparent the ghost appears in your scene. In the examples images I provided I placed the ghost in a haunted house scene. *****Haunted house and pumpkin not included in this download. 
There is perhaps no Halloween costume more clichéd than the easy-peasy “bedsheet ghost,” the most primitive of which can be fashioned with nothing but white linens and scissors for eyeholes.We’ve seen it worn by characters like Charlie Brown, Michael Myers and Spongebob Squarepants (who was chagrined to be mistaken for a “haunted mattress,” prompting him to shave down his rectangular body’s corners.)But if pop culture has solidified our image of this DIY spectre as a go-to Trick-or-Treating getup, then it begs the question: how the heck did we decide that ghosts look like walking sheets? Given the major influx of Irish arrivals in wake of the mid-19th Century potato famine, it is no surprise that Halloween borrows heavily from Celtic paganism: including nods to spirits of ancestral dead, costumes, and a neighborly ritual that would eventually become Trick-or-Treating. Early Halloween costumes tended to be simple, spooky, and cheap--which naturally led to bedsheet ghosts.

Modern modular container home 3d model is mado of 3 x 40 ft and 1x 20 ft container.CustomizedDue to their shape and material, shipping containers can be easily modified to fit many purposes.Strength and durabilityShipping containers are designed to be stacked in high columns, carrying heavy loads. They are also designed to resist harsh environments, such as on ocean-going vessels or sprayed with road salt while transported on roads. Due to their high strength, shipping containers are usually the last to fall in extreme weather, such as tornadoes, hurricanes, and tsunamis.ModularAll shipping containers are the same width and most have two standard height and length measurements and as such they provide modular elements that can be combined into larger structures. This simplifies design, planning and transport. As they are already designed to interlock for ease of mobility during transportation, structural construction is completed by simply emplacing them. Due to the containers' modular design, additional construction is as easy as stacking more containers. They can be stacked up to 12 units high when empty.LaborThe welding and cutting of steel is considered to be specialized labor and can increase construction expenses, yet overall it is still lower than conventional construction. Unlike wood frame construction, attachments must be welded or drilled to the outer skin, which is more time consuming and requires different job site equipment.TransportBecause they already conform to standard shipping sizes, pre-fabricated modules can be easily transported by ship, truck, or rail.AvailabilityBecause of their wide-spread use, new and used shipping containers are available across the planet.ExpenseMany used containers are available at an amount that is low compared to a finished structure built by other labor-intensive means such as bricks and mortar — which also require larger more expensive foundations.[citation needed]Eco-friendlyA 40 ft shipping container weights over 3,500 kg. When upcycling shipping containers, thousands of kilograms of steel are saved. In addition when building with containers, the amount of traditional building materials needed (i.e. bricks and cement) are reduced.
